actual.descripcion: Jack Burns, a man out of step with his time and one of the last of the real cowboys, takes on an encroaching modern world of jeeps and helicopters when he breaks out of jail in an act of defiance embodying the spirit of the Old West.

siguiente.descripcion: A cavalry lieutenant assigned to a fort in Florida helps the Seminole Indians remain free of European settlers' laws in the 19th century.

There's mayhem when motorway patrollers discover a car on fire and leaking fuel. A broken-down van blocks a slip road, and a four-vehicle pile-up causes chaos on Spaghetti Junction.

PC Rich Woodward is on the hunt for a suspect in an uninsured vehicle that has been spotted swerving along the motorway. Upon questioning, Rich believes there is more to the suspect's problematic driving, and he conducts a drugs test.

A reverse ramming sends Chris reaching for German shepherd Ronny, Lee is confronted by a particularly mouthy motorist, Liam arrests a man who denies carrying out a shocking attack, tasers are drawn after a van driver causes carnage, and a wanted man holes up in a loft and refuses to come quietly.

Interceptor Spike takes the lead against a runaway car thief in one of the most challenging pursuits ever. Liam investigates a gang of suspected drug dealers. A supposedly straightforward stop snowballs into a showdown with an aggressive youngster.

Inspector Anton Sullivan is on the hunt for an escaped prisoner who is believed to be a high risk to the public. Anton is called to a serious collision on the M56 involving a motorcyclist and multiple vehicles.

A suspected stolen Mini is pursued in icy Nottingham, and after nearly hitting a man walking his dog, police have a familiar face in handcuffs once again. Meanwhile, the Knife Crime team have a couple of suspected drug users under observation.

A new competitor on the Coq has cut Jamie's business in half, and the one job he lands in weeks ends up being a complex recovery that no one seems willing to pay for, making Heavy Rescue face a life and death decision.
Holidaying Scully meets a girl who makes people injure themselves. Written by Stephen King and Chris Carter.

Covered in tattoos, his terrifying appearance adds to Jaime Osuna being one of the most feared men in the US prison system. Awaiting trial, he began practising Satanism and attempted to kill a fellow inmate.
Dirt road veteran Dennis Dent goes head-to-head with a lifelong nemesis. Meanwhile, Christian Reynolds takes on the wild back country on a vital mission to build a bridge.
Kings Heavy Haulage are tasked to move a 19-metre-long, 44-ton bridge, made out of steel and glass, six miles from a yard on the outskirts of Gloucester right through the city centre.

In Brixham on Devon's south coast, specialist train hauliers Ant and Paul take on the challenge of lifting and shifting a steam locomotive and tender to a new home at Kingsley and Froghall Station in Stoke-on-Trent.
